name: Elixir of Suffering
label: Quest
description: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon brews a venomous concoction intended to further the Royal Apothecary Society's sinister work. To confirm its lethality…
intro: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon brews a venomous concoction intended to further the Royal Apothecary Society's sinister work. To confirm its lethality, he orders an immediate live trial on his unfortunate companion nearby.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It will take but a moment for me to mix these components into what I have deemed an Elixir of Suffering.
There we go! Ah, nothing brightens a gloomy day in these miserable foothills like bringing a little suffering into the world.
Let us see if our little potion has achieved its desired effect.
Give my assistant Umpi a taste of what the Dark Lady has planned for both humans and Scourge alike.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
